description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget class BannerLStyle1, which extends StatelessWidget. It constructs a stylized banner for a Flutter e-commerce UI, featuring a discount percentage, optional subtitle, and a call-to-action text. The widget composes various Flutter UI elements such as Text, Stack, Padding, and custom BannerL widget.
